results.content:
Evaluating 82 reviews, reviewers overwhelmingly had a great experience with this company. Customers frequently praise the incredibly helpful staff, responsive case managers, and the intuitive digital platform that makes home buying smooth and stress free. People consistently highlight the professional legal guidance and prompt email responses received throughout their entire journey. Some reviewe rs were not happy with communication delays, citing instances of unresponsiveness, lack of proactive updates, and prolonged mortgage drawdowns. ## I’m happy with the service overall
I’m happy with the service overall. Laurie Murphy was great to deal with — always prompt, clear, and genuinely helpful whenever I reached out. The process itself was smooth, and the platform made things easy to follow. The only reason I’m giving four stars instead of five is that I had to chase a couple of updates myself along the way, though it wasn’t a big issue. Overall, a positive experience and I’d happily use Beam again.
